# Damn Delicious

> > A recipe blog by Chungah Rhee featuring quick, easy comfort food recipes with step-by-step instructions.

Damn Delicious specializes in approachable home cooking with emphasis on 30-minute meals, slow cooker recipes, and Italian-inspired dishes. The site features recipes that have been highlighted in publications like Bon Appetit and TODAY, focusing on weeknight-friendly comfort food that doesn't sacrifice flavor.

## Key Topics

- Easy dinner recipes
- 30-minute meals
- Slow cooker recipes
- Italian-inspired cooking
- Comfort food
- Weeknight meals
- One-pot pasta
- Breakfast recipes
- Quick cooking techniques
- Shrimp recipes
- Baked dishes
- Chungah Rhee (recipe developer)
- No-bake desserts
- Healthy smoothies

## Quick Weeknight Dinners

- [One Pot Shrimp Parmesan Pasta](https://damndelicious.net/2015/03/30/one-pot-shrimp-parmesan-pasta): Easy one-pot shrimp pasta with Ragú sauce, cooked in single pot
- [Baked Ravioli](https://damndelicious.net/2014/01/07/baked-ravioli): 30-minute cheesy baked ravioli, perfect weeknight comfort food
- [Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers](https://damndelicious.net/2013/06/03/quinoa-stuffed-bell-peppers): Healthy vegetarian quinoa stuffed bell peppers, southwest-style
- [Pecan Crusted Salmon with Lemon Glaze](https://damndelicious.net/2015/05/04/pecan-crusted-salmon-with-lemon-glaze): 5-minute pecan-crusted salmon with lemon glaze using Fisher Nuts
- [Parmesan Tortellini Bites](https://damndelicious.net/2014/09/29/parmesan-tortellini-bites): Crispy fried parmesan tortellini bites, addictive party appetizer

## Slow Cooker Recipes

- [Slow Cooker Corn Chowder](https://damndelicious.net/2019/05/28/slow-cooker-corn-chowder): Easy crockpot corn chowder with fresh corn, bacon, and potatoes
- [Slow Cooker Garlic Parmesan Potatoes](https://damndelicious.net/2014/12/23/slow-cooker-garlic-parmesan-potatoes): Crisp-tender garlic parmesan potatoes made easy in the crockpot
- [Slow Cooker Corned Beef](https://damndelicious.net/2015/03/02/slow-cooker-corned-beef): Tender slow cooker corned beef brisket for St. Patrick's Day
- [Slow Cooker Potato and Corn Chowder](https://damndelicious.net/2014/09/12/slow-cooker-potato-corn-chowder): Easy crockpot potato corn chowder, freezer-friendly comfort food

## Sandwiches & Handheld Meals

- [Baked Ham and Cheese Croissants](https://damndelicious.net/2019/09/20/baked-ham-and-cheese-croissants): Mini ham & Swiss croissants with Dijon-honey butter, crowd-pleaser
- [Carnitas Avocado Pizza](https://damndelicious.net/2012/09/16/carnitas-avocado-pizza-with-chipotle-avocado-mayonnaise): Mexican fusion pizza with slow-cooked carnitas and chipotle mayo
- [Shrimp Sandwich with Avocado and Broccoli Slaw](https://damndelicious.net/2013/06/01/shrimp-sandwich-with-avocado-and-broccoli-slaw): Roasted shrimp sandwich with avocado and homemade broccoli slaw
- [Salmon BLT Sliders with Chipotle Mayo](https://damndelicious.net/2012/06/06/salmon-blt-sliders-with-chipotle-mayo): Baked salmon BLT sliders with bacon and chipotle mayo

## Breakfast & Brunch

- [Banana Stuffed French Toast](https://damndelicious.net/2015/02/16/banana-stuffed-french-toast): Banana-stuffed French toast with cornflake coating, heart-healthy
- [Strawberry Pineapple Kale Smoothie](https://damndelicious.net/2015/05/25/strawberry-pineapple-kale-smoothie): Nutritious kale smoothie with strawberry and pineapple, healthy breakfast
- [Banana Bread Kit Kat Muffins](https://damndelicious.net/2012/09/10/muffinmonday-banana-bread-kit-kat-muffins): Indulgent banana bread muffins with Kit Kat and crumb topping

## Desserts & Sweet Treats

- [No Bake Vanilla Bean Cheesecake Blueberry Pie](https://damndelicious.net/2013/06/24/no-bake-vanilla-bean-cheesecake-blueberry-pie): No-bake vanilla bean cheesecake blueberry pie in mason jars
- [Cantaloupe Popsicles](https://damndelicious.net/2013/08/08/cantaloupe-popsicles): 3-ingredient cantaloupe popsicles inspired by Korean Melona bars
